text_block_list.text: It was finally here——the day of the mock race.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Kraft and the others' latest data……? That's amazing, 
you've been gathering data all the way until the end.
choice_data_list: Let's base our new strategy on this
Let's base our new strategy on this

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, having a capable trainer on 
your side…… is really reassuring, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
——It's like you're reading my mind and putting 
it in to 『Words』. Let's win this. The two of us!

I had been watching over Daring Heart as her provisional trainer, 
adjusting her training menu as needed. All for the sake of today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu…… So serious and tense…… 
It almost looks like you're the one running today.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm just a little nervous……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Heh. Hey…… just who do you think I am?

That Daring smile was all it took to 
completely overwrite the anxiety I felt.

She was waiting. Waiting for me to call out the name 
that would cast aside all doubts to seize victory——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
——Be Daring. Now…… let me hear it. 
The name of the Queen you believe in.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Go on, say it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Okay…! I'm heading out! 
My Queendom…… these are the first steps!

With a flawless start, Daring Heart surged forward. 
Aiming to take control of the race, it was a calm, composed run.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(……I can hear it. The sound of the wind rushing past, 
feet kicking at the turf. The breath of my rivals——…… 
Yeah, not yet. There's no reason to panic)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(……The theory aligns with my intuition. Just like the 
data you gave me predicted, I am controlling the pace……)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Stay calm…… there's no need for excess power. 
Just wait for the right moment——)

And then as the race reached the 
final stages, everyone made their move——!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Here——!! Haaaaaaaaaーーーー!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fuu——……!! 
Haaaaaaaa————!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(——Here they come. Their footsteps, this pressure…… 
Ahhh, it makes my heart race……!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(This is the world I was seeking. Noble, yet gritty. 
Hearts laid bare, clashing, heart to heart——!)

Daring Heart had been running while minimizing any 
excess movement up to this point. ——All to unleash 
her explosive power and leave her rivals behind!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I've rested my wings. My Heart is full. Then…… 
All that's left is to fly high——higher than anyone else!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me! Don't look away! 
Now, in this moment…… I am the Queen that shines brightest of all!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Go…… Daring Heart——!! 
Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……Haa……! 
Haa…… haa…… haa……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
————……Kuu! 
They passed me…… got in front of me——……!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Just a little more…… really just a little——……
choice_data_list: It was good…… especially the last spurt!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But…… no matter how close, a loss is a loss. 
I——couldn't reach victory.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……Fufu…… but, it's still a refreshing feeling. 
Right, it truly is…… a good feeling.

As if to hide her trembling hands——to crush the feeling of 
frustration within——Daring Heart clenched her fists tightly.
My mind was made up as I approached her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
How strange…… when you touch my shoulder…… 
It's almost like I can feel it all melting away.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Your hand…… perhaps has some magic in it?
choice_data_list: It's just…… the hand of an amateur

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No…… it's almost like my favorite blanket. 
Warm…… gentle, and comforting.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……A hand that brings with it, peace.

——I might be able to support her. Even if I was indulging in 
my own delusions…… I felt that right now, I would be forgiven.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that bicycle…… you're gonna ride beside me today too, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For me, today, there's something I want to confirm. 
Let's get going! Let's get right to it!

Daring Heart——without ever looking back—— 
Simply accelerated towards her own ideals.

That first day that I rode after her. With a sharpness 
that made it hard to follow her, watching her continue 
to pull away, I was struck by her sheer determination.

How far away she felt. How overwhelming. But that——is precisely 
why my Heart surged. I was completely captivated by her running.
I pedaled harder. In that instant——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Let's go together! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufuu…… what's with that funny face!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you the one that told me though!? 
That it wasn't good to push so hard.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In that case…… I figured standing side by side with 
someone, moving forward together, wouldn't be so bad.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……By resting my wings, I could fly 
higher, you're the one that said it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I want to become stronger. 
With a stronger Heart——I want to fly even higher.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why…… 
Hey, will you be the one to be my perch?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ——Be my partner…… as my Trainer.

I would continue to support and watch over her. So that this 
beautiful, noble Heart could one day reach the Tiara——
choice_data_list: Yeah…… even higher in to the sky——!
Yeah…… even higher in to the sky——!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu……! The breeze…… feels quite nice. 
It's truly been a lovely morning……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Together with you——it's the best kind of beginning, don't you think?♪

The soft morning light enveloped everything around us. 
A radiant path to glory…… and we'd run it together, side by side.
